definitions.full: H6768. Tseleq צֶ֫לֶק proper name, masculine Ammonite hero of David 2Sam 23:37 = 1Chr 11:39 , Ελειε , Σελ ( λ ) η ( κ ), Σαλααδ , etc. צִלְּתַי see III. צלל . P.853
